presets.name: Solo MVP
presets.optimize_for: Fastest path to a working product for one builder: boring proven tech, one deployable unit, near-zero operations, easy to abandon or grow.

presets.name: API service
presets.optimize_for: A long-lived network service: clean API boundaries, observability from day one, horizontal deployability, schema-versioned persistence.

presets.name: CLI tool
presets.optimize_for: A single trivially-installable binary or package: instant startup, no server components, great help text, scriptable output.

presets.name: Browser extension
presets.optimize_for: Manifest V3 reality: minimal permissions, store-review friendliness, no remote code, graceful degradation when offline.

presets.name: Data pipeline
presets.optimize_for: Idempotent re-runnable stages, explicit schema evolution, observable progress, cheap backfills, failure isolation between stages.
